purpose: How many teams remain when listing order does not matter?
meaning: Count each unordered team once. Every team has k! ordered listings, so divide ordered selections by this common multiplicity; Pascal recurrence provides the runtime count.

definition.setting: Choose k volunteers from n available people for a team with no distinct roles. The same members in another listing order are still one team.

signature.k: Number of people in a team.
signature.C(n,k): Number of unordered k-person subsets of the n-person group.
signature.k!: Number of ordered listings corresponding to one team.

conditions: Whole counts satisfy 0 ≤ k ≤ n ≤ 10. Zero chosen people and choosing everybody each give one selection. A displayed prefix of teams is labeled and is never substituted for the full count.
All chosen inputs are whole numbers in the declared finite ranges. Both views and the story use the same evaluated state.
